tei:div.tei:p: 1) ༄༅/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po'i mkha' 'gro yang tig yid bzhin nor bu gzhan phan 'od kyi 'khor lo btang tshul ni/ 2)

༄༅// rtsa gtor bskong chog gtor ma rnams ni zhi khro ngan song sbyong ba dang 'dra/ dkar bgegs/ brtan ma/ thun gtor/ dkaragator cha lnga/ yang bgegs gtor gcig tshogs/ zhi sbyong*/ bye ma/ til sbyong*/ gtso las bum pa/ me long*/ khrus dar/ khrus gzhong*/ dbu rgyan/ rdor dril cha gnyis/ gsang thod/ rig tsaka me long*/ shel rdo/ dbu rgyan/ rigs lnga'i sku yod na des chog med na rigs lnga'i sku+u mig dar/ me tog gser thur/ lha thur/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya rnams bzang ngan/ gzung thag dung chos/ zas bsngo la/ me ldog/ ting shag spos/ phye mar/ dar ras/ ming byang*/ rgyal srid bdun sogs/ mchod pa 'dzom tshad bcas bsog cho ga dngos la sa sta thig chog zur du gsal dngos gzhi la sems bskyed sdom chog gnas lugs rtogs pa skye ba yan gsol 'debs bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ḥ byin brlabs bdud rtsi'i= badz+rar ma hā shrī= nas/ s+tha na= yan/ gzhung 'di nyid kyi yo gas/ gang dag 'dir gnas= nas/ mdzad du gsol/ zhi rol/ dkar/ bhu mi pa ti sarba bhigh+naṃ= gsum/ sa phyogs 'dir gnas= yo ga suṃ bha ni/ zhi rol/ dkar/ dung*/ rkang*/ oṃ badz+ra kro dhā= gang bar gyur/ zhi rol/ rgya/ dung*/ dkar/ rang gi snying ga'i zhi khro sgyu 'phrul rnam par rol pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs= tshe las 'das pas= mchi'o/ gsum/ chos thams cad= sgoms/ gsum/ 3) sems can thams cad= gsum/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ tshogs zhing*/ swa bhā wa/ phyi nang gi= badz+ra dzi ha lag gnyis bkan/ h+ya gṛ ba= 'dod rgya phyogs mtshams bstan/ yo ga bzhi dril/ hūm̐ḥ rab 'jigs= suṃ bha la 'dod rgya/ shar dang shar lho/ lho dang lho nub/ nub dang nub byang*/ byang dang byang shar/ steng 'og phyogs mtshams/ yo ga bzhi dril/ hūm̐ ye shes= gshegs su gsol/ zhi rol/ rgya dkar/ dung*/ rkang*/ steng gi/ shab+da= zhi rol/ rgya/ dkar/ dung*/ dzaḥhūm̐= hūm̐ḥ chos nyid= yo ga bzhi dril/ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ zhi rol/ dung*/ rkang*/ dkar/ gu gul 'grim/

bgegs thams cad= yig brgya/ dri sil/ yo ga shud+dho= phyi nang*/ hūm̐ḥ kun tu bzang po= yo ga bzhi dril/ zhi rol/ rgya dung rkang*/ dkar/ ye shes pa= 'di man dmigs bsal rnams ma gtogs yo ga bzhi dril kho na yin/ pū dza me gha= zhi rol/ rgya/ dung*/ dkar/ ḍā/ ngang nyid= rigs spyi phyag dzaḥhūm̐ḥbud+dha thal sbyar spyi bor/ badz+ra= rtsa gsum= dpral/ rat+na= thal sbyar/ rna g.yas/ pad+ma= thal sbyar kha phye/ ltag karma= sor bsnol/ rna g.yon/ spyi bo'am thugs kar ston par gyur/ bzlas pa sum brgya/ oṃ āḥhūṃ phyi nang= zhi rol/ rgya/ dung*/ dkar/ ḍā/ rdor sems mchod gdangs sam/ yo gas/ oṃ phyogs bcu= rgya/ mchod phreng ltar/ shab+da/ zhi rol/ rgya/ dung*/ dkar/ ḍā/ hūm̐ 4) snod bcud= gdangs/ gong ltar/ ke lo rgya/ gsang ba'i 'khyud rgya/ hūm̐ḥ rang bzhin= yo ga mnyam bzhag gnyis/ spyi phyag gcig oṃ āḥhūm̐ḥ swa bhā ba= stong pa'i= bsnyen pa sum brgya/ badz+ra kro ta= bsnyen pa brgya/ sarba ta thā= lnga bcu/ mchod gdas sam/ yo ga shab+da= zhi rol/ rgya/ dung dkar/ bstod pa spyi phyag dung chu phul/ badz+ra muḥ chur gyur/ zhog tshogs grol/ ༈ badz+ra kro dha shu n+ya ta= phyi dang= ma lus sems can= spyan 'dren gdangs chen/ dus gsum/ yo ga zhi rol/ dung*/ rgya/ dkar/ rkang*/ ḍā/ bla ma dkyil 'khor= hūm̐/ sgyu ma= yo ga me tog rgya/ chu dang thang skyes= rdor sems mchod gdangs/ shab+da/ zhi rol/ rgya/ dung dkar/ gzhan yang*/ yo ga sku gsum thugs nyid= spyi phyag aṃ ku rgya/ rnal 'byor bsdam mdzub mo g.yon steng*/ g.yas lcags kyu pa sha/ mdzub mo bkug s+pho ṭa/ re mig pra be/ mthe bong gnyis nang*/ dan rgya rnams gong ltar/ ji ltar khrus gdangs kyis/ ji ltar/ lha khrus tshul bzhin dgos/ phyed rol/ rgya/ dkar/ dung*/ dbang bskur bas dbu brgyan par gyur/ dpe 'dzom na/ phyag gdangs kyis/ ji ltar= phyag 'tshal= dri med= zla rgyas= oṃ hūm̐= lha rdzas= khyab par gyur/ zhi rol/ rgya/ dung*/ dkar/ bde bar gshegs pa/

rdor sems mchod gdangs/ phyag rgya mchan ltar/ ṣarga= zhi rol/ rgya/ dung*/ dkar/ snod bcud= 5) kha dog dbyibs legs/ gdangs/ shab+da= bzhi bsdebs man yo ga rdo rje sems dpa'= sgeg mo'i snyan glu/ gsang mchog sku yi= kun tu dga' ba'i gdangs/ mu ra dze= bzhi bsdebs/ man+dhe ke zhi rol/ dkar/ rgya/ dung*/ rtsa brgyad man yo ga dharma kā yaḥ dril stabs/ bstod pa/ mnyam bzhag rigs lnga kha phral spyi phyag gtor ma lnga la/ zhi rol lnga/ dkar/ rgya/ dung*/ na mo bdag gi= yo ga de ltar= lhug thon par gyur cig 'di bdag 'jug pad+ma klong yangs nas/ ji ltar/ khrus gdangs/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ bi shwa= zhi rol/ dung*/ rkang*/ sa gzhi= 'di man nas khrus gdangs dngos dang*/ lhug spel ma bya/ e ma dus gsum= e ma snod dang= phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas= kun bzang rigs lnga= dpa' bo dpa' mo= bla ma kun bzang= ho bla ma kun bzang= sngon gyi rgyal ba= 'di bzung byang chub= yar mchod gus shing= slob ma rnams= badz+ra pra be= bla ma yi dam= zhi rol/ dung*/ dkar/ rgya/ rkang*/ ḍā/ oṃ hūm̐= 'jig rten du ni= chos rnams gzugs brnyan= oṃ āḥhūm̐ mig dar/ a khaṃ= me tog kyai khro bo mi bzad= khyed su= bdag ni= bishwa= zhi rol/ dung*/ rkang*/ sa gzhi= kyai rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas= kyai bla ma= e ma bdag ni= e ma nang 6) mchod myong*/ 'o khyod kyi snying la bla ma dang*/ zhi rol brgyud gsum/ g.yab dar gcig dkar/ rgya/ dung*/ rkang*/ ḍā/ kyai shar sgo= bde gshegs= me tog bkram/ ston pa= rdo rjes mig dar bsal/ kye ma sa gzhi= kun bzang= shar sgo/ me tog mgor bzhag/ rdo rje bzung*/ rdor gser gyis/ dbang gdangs 'bring ba/ rigs kyi slob ma= 'dinas dbang gdangs chung ba dang lhug spel ma/ hūm̐ḥ 'du shes= rdo rje gser nang*/ 'o rigs kyi bu slob ma= hūm̐ḥ rnam shes= rdo dril bsnol te/ lag g.yas/ sngags la spyi bor dkrol/ 'o rigs kyi slob ma= hūm̐/ tshor ba'i phung po= dbu rgyan bzung tshul dang gyon tshul/

'o rigs kyi slob ma= hūm̐/ 'du byed= dril bu dkrol ltar gzungs sngags la dkrol/ 'o rigs kyi slob ma= oṃ hūm̐= thabs dang= rdor gser/ 'khyud rgya/ 'o rigs kyi= bla mas bum pa bzung*/ gzhan gyis gzung tshul/ hūm̐ḥ rdo rje= rdor gsol/ 'di man yo ga kho nas/ nang 'dren/ 'o rigs kyi bu= bla mas dbu brgyan bzung*/ gzhan rnams gzung tshul/ 'o rigs kyi= e ma= de nas sa gzhi= e ma= mig dar/ rdo rje/ zhi rol/ dkar/ rgya/ dung*/ ḍā/ mig dar phye/ 'byung ba'i= kye ma= e ma= kye ma= sa gzhi= kye= e ma= shi'am= thams cad= zhi rol/ dkar/ rgya/ dung*/ rkang*/ ḍā/ dus gsum= gnyis/ dril bu rdor sems ltar bzung*/ bum gdangs/ ye shes lha mo= e ma= 7) sa gzhi= kye ma gnyis/ slob ma'i= zhi rol/ dkar/ rgya/ dung*/ rkang*/ ḍā/ e ma bzhi/ tshogs dag= kye mar= sa gzhi= deng nas= bzung bar mdzod/ tsha rting grol/ ༈ las rdor gyis phyag gsum/ tshe 'das la zhu/ badz+ra kro dha= 'gugs pa gsum/ sngags rnams brgya/ sarba bug+naṃ= gsum/ suṃ bha= gsum/ hūm̐ḥ ye shes bskal pa'i= tshig rkang brgyad da nang ltar/ zhi rol/ rgya/ dkar/ dung*/ rkang*/ shab+da= zhi rol/ dkar/ rgya/ dung*/ hūm̐ḥ chos nyid= dpal chen yab yum gnyis la phyag 'tshal bstod/ bar/ hūm̐ḥ 'jigs pa'i/ yo ga kho na/ suṃ bha ni= zhi rol/ dung*/ rkang*/ bgegs rnams/ me chu til gsum/ bye ma brab/ lha khrus phyed rol gsum/ dkar/ rgya/ dung*/ sku phyi/ dug khrus rol bzhi/ 'dod chags zhe sdang= gsum/ 'byung ba bzhi so so/ shis brjod/ zhi rol/ dkar/ rgya/ dung*/ rkang*/ phyag 'tshal gong gi gdangs/ maṇ+ḍal/ zhu len/ so byang sngags/ gdangs bdag 'jug ltar/ mig dar/ me tog/ sgo zhus/ dri lan/ bi shwa= zhi dra rol/ dung*/ rkang*/ zhu len/ dbab/ zhi rol/ rgya/ dung/ dkar/ rkang*/ ḍā/ sgo dbye/ me tog dor/ mig dbye/ bstan/ maṇ+ḍal/ zhu/ me tog mgor/ bum pa/ rdo rje/ rdor dril/ dbu rgyan/ dril bu/ rdor dril/ rnam bum/ rigs lnga'i sku/ ngo sprod dam tshig

maṇ+ḍal/ gtang rag oṃ hūm̐= 'dod yon/ 8) tshig bstun slob dpon bkyag kha dog= rang gdangs/ shab+da= bzhi bsdebs/ phyag 'tshal bstod/ thams cad nam mkha'i= byang bu me sbar/ lam bstan/ sangs rgyas par gyur/ zangs mdog gzhi lam/ sku gsum/ bar do/ dus mthar/ gung tshogs grol/ ༈ phyi dro gsol ka cha tshang*/ bar tshogs dang po grol/ tshogs mchod rgya mtsho'i spyan 'dren/ las rdor phyag bcas zhu/ bgegs bskrad/ zhi rol/ dung*/ rkang*/ bgegs thams cad= mtshams bcad tshogs zhing spyen/ zhi rol/ dkar/ rgya/ dung*/ rkang*/ ḍā/ bzhugs phyag sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ tshogs byin rlabs/ phyi nang= shar/ zhi rol/ rgya/ dkar/ dung nang rkang lnga/ ḍā 'ur/ gsang de kho/ bdud rtsi/ gtor ma/ tshogs phud/ zhi rol/ dkar/ rgya/ dung*/ bstod bshags bskul/ zhi rol/ dung*/ rkang*/ drang ba/ tshogs grol/ ༈ lhag ma/ zhi rol/ dung*/ rkang*/ brtan ma/ zhi rol/ rgya/ dung*/ bro brdung*/ bshags pa/ smon lam/ bsam pa 'grub par shog ngo bo rang bzhin ni= zhi rol/ rgya/ dkar/ dung*/ rkang*/ ḍā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mnyam par gyur/ zhi rol/ rgya/ dkar/ dung*/ ḍā/ chu dang mchod gdangs/ bstod pa yo ga spyi phyag sems can= yo ga gang yang*/ lhug yig brgya gsum/ bsngo ba gnyis lhug oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'dir ni= su pra= dam tshig pa= rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas= dang*/ phun sum tshogs pa= rang gdangs 9) zhi rol/ brgyud gsum spyi ltar/ bsod nams 'di yi= man spyi 'gro ltar bya/ dril chog mchod rol can rnams la tshog bsgrigs 'di ltar la/ grong chog song dus/ tshig bdun gsol 'debs mthar/ rol mo byin rlabs zhi rol brdung srol snang*/ tshig lhug 'than cha rigs skabs bab dpyad na shes/ nyin mang po 'don dus nyin snga ma rnams/ bkra shis rol mo zhi rol gcig kyang*/ nyin tha mar brgyud gsum tshogs bsgrigs nang mdzad/ grong chog sogs la brgyud gsum nyin re brdung*/ rnga chog rigs kyi/ sngags/ dza hūṃ baṃ ho/ gar yod rnga re re bzhin yod/

khā hi la de bzhin/ sa ma ya/ a la la/ pha ra dza/ a pa na/ nai wi d+ya/ de rnams gar yod la rnga re re las brdung srol med/ gzhan phan 'od kyi 'khor lo 'di rdzogs pa chen po'i rgyud bcu bdun nang nas rdzogs chen rang byung rgyud kyi dngos bstan yin/ zhi khro ngan song sbyong ba/ bka' ma dong sprugs pad+ma brgya ldan dang zung du 'jug la/ gnas 'dren rdzogs pa chen po klong rgyud kyi dngos bstan yin pas rdzogs pa chen po nyams su len mkhan zhig 'chi dus 'di 10) gnyis gang rung ma tshar na/ cho ga gzhan gyis phan gnod ci'ang med/ so so'i skye bo tha ma pa la gshin chog 'di gnyis gang rung tshar na skye ba de mthar rdzogs pa chen po sgom pa'i lus su skye/ tshe 'di'am bar dor grol nges yin pas 'di brten gal che che// dge'o// 11) ༄༅/ nyer lnga la yum ka'i tshogs bskang 'don lugs ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ nas/ dkon mchog rjes dran= chen po'o/ mgon po thugs rje= sho lo ka lnga/ skye bar shog= ngan 'gro= tshig bcad gnyis/ dkon mchog= bid pu ra la gsum/ pad bskor gnyis/ gar bsgor/ se gol re/ phun sum tshogs pa'i= nam mdzod gsum la pad/ thal sbyar/ se gol/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ nas zhi rol/ dung dkar rgya dril/ phyogs dus kun nas= bzhi dril gshegs su gsol/ zhi rol/ dung kar rgya dril/ bcom ldan 'dir ni= pad+ma ka ya la ye staṃ/ pad rgya/ bla ma= tshig bzhi/ dkon mchog gsum la= skur gyur pa ni= bdag phyag 'tshal/ sangs rgyas shākya thub= dang po dga' ldan= 'gyur bar shog 'phags pa 'jam dpal= bdag gis bstod/ rin chen sems de= oṃ badz+ra bhu mi= ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ yi dam rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul bar bgyi'o/ thugs rjes= sa gzhi= traṃ gu ru= oṃ= stong gsum=

tshig bcad gsum/ bdag gzhan dus gsum= sngags bcas/ sku gsum yongs rdzogs= mnyes byed= me tog= tshig bcad gsum/ bla ma rgyal ba = tshig bcad gnyis/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa= ldeb shar/ bdag sogs sems can thams cad dus rtag= ltung shags/ nye bar mchi'o/ 'dod chags zhe sdang=(12)phyogs bcu'i= gang rnams= mya ngan= phyag 'tshal ba dang= phyir bsngo'o/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dam pa dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad nye ring chags sdang gnyis dang bral ba'i btang snyoms chen po'i ngang la sems rab tu gnas par gyur cig lus dang de bzhin= phyogs bcu na= byang chub= nas/ bslab par bgyi/ yan lan gsum/ deng dus= tshig bcad brgyad/ de bzhin gshegs pa = oṃ a mo gha= tshar gsum/ bdag sogs= khrims kyi= rgyal ba= hūm̐: o rgyan yul gyi= tshar gsum/ sku gsum gsol 'debs/ lhu gsum/ 'di ltar= lhu bzhi/ 'dzam gling*/ tshig bcad drug brgyud 'debs/ gu ru dhe ba= mthu thob shog dung chen/ dril/ thing gsum/ sil/ ḍā rkang gsum/ bzhag rol/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ na mo skye med ye shes= lan gsum/ hoḥ 'di nas= lan gsum/ rigs 'dus kyi/ hoḥ chu las chu bur= lan gsum/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ tshogs zhing rnams rang la (13 thim par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā shṛ he ru ka ko3 haṃ: bdag nyid rdo rje khro bo'i skur gyur/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ swa bhā wa= stog pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+ruṃ las rin po che'i snod zab cing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/
oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsum/ rgya bcas/ bhumi pa ti sa pā ri bā ra badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ bsdu rgya/ s+tha na pa ti k+ṣe pra pa lañtsa na ma ཿsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yoḥ gsum/ pad nam mdzod/ se gol bcas yo gas/

gang dag 'dir gnas lha dang klu// gnod sbyin srin po'am gzhan dag la// dkyil 'khor don du sa phyogs 'di// bdag zhu khyed kyis bstsal du gsol/ zhi rol/ dkar dril/ bhu mi pa ti ya hi gats+tshaḥ sarba bhu ta a kar k+ṣa ya dzaḥ sarba big+nan na maḥsarba ta thā ta te bh+yo= ghṛh+ṇe daṃ bha lin+ta ye swa hā/ gsum/ rgya/ dung chen/ dril/ thing gsum/ sil/ sum gnyis/ rigs 'dus kyi/ hrīḥ snod bcud sprul pa'i= rdo rjes gzhomaḥ dung chen/ sum gcig sil/ rkang bzhi/ sum gnyis/ hrīḥ snang srid= byin 'bebs mgor/ sum gnyis/ dung chen/ rgya/ g.yab dar dmar gcig hūm̐ spros bral= dngos grub stsolaḥ (musical notes and signs here) sil/ ḍā/ rkang bzhi/ gzhag rol/ rgya/(14)dung chen/ yum ka'i/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ḥ dngos por= mthar dung chen rgya ḍā thing gcig sil/ sum gnyis/ āḥ snang ba= spyan 'dren mgor/ rgya rkang bzhi/ dung chen/ g.yab gcig sum gnyis/ hūm̐: yul gyi= mthar g.yab gcig rgya dung rkang bzhi/ ḍā/ 'jam rol/ sum gnyis/ hoḥ gdod nas= mchod pa'i mthar 'jam rol/ rgya dung rkang bzhi/ ḍā/ sum gnyis/ hūm̐ḥ rgyal ba= bstod pa'i mthar/ dung chen/ sum gcig sil bzhag rol/ bsnyen dmigs lhug pad+mo yo gi ni gsum brgya/ guh+ya dzñā na= brgya/ oṃ a āḥ sogs dbyangs gsal/ yig brgya/ rten snying*/ shra ma ṇa 'grub par gyur cig swa hā/ lan gsum/ mchod phreng*/ oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrī āḥ nam mdzod mthar zhi rol/ rgya dung dkar ḍā/ pad+ma rgyas pa= lha mo bzhi re'i mtshas su zhi rol bzhi la/ rgya dung dkar/ las byang gzhung mchod/ zhi rol/ rgya dung dkar/ ḍā/ bstod pa rtsa gdangs/ rigs lnga spyi phyag yig brgya lan gcig dril bsil/ gsol ka rang nyid dpal chen por= nas sku gsum brgyud gsum= mthar/ dam chen rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams= kun 'grub mdzod/ sumagacig sil/ zhag rol/ dung rgya/ bla ma rig 'dzin rgyal ba zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad bdun gyi nam mkha' badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

na rag skong shags/ e ma hoḥ phyogs bcu= yig brgya nyer gcig tsam/ hoḥ zhi khro= hūm̐ḥ ma bcos= la bzhi dril/ sman rak+ta/ gtor ma/ mar me bzhi la/ ṇi rol/ rgya dung dkar/ hūm̐ḥ(15)bka' gsang rmad du= mthar zhi rol/ rgya dung dkar/ ḍā/ hūm̐ḥ dus gsum= mthar tshogs zhus/ 'dir tshogs grol yod na/ rgya dung rkang bzhi/ ḍā/ thing gsum/ zil/ sum gnyis/ tshogs grol med na/ rgya gdung chen/ thing gcig (Musical notes and signs here) hā+oḥ bde ba= tshig bzhi/ rgya/ dung chen/ sum gnyis/ hūm̐ḥ 'og min= mchog dang thun mong dngos grub= lhu gsum/ sum gnyis/ rgya dung chen/ hoḥ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i 'jam rol mthar bzhag rol kha 'bud med/ skong bshags kyi/ na moḥ bde gshegs= lhug nam mdzod mthar rkang bzhi/ dung rgya/ g.yab/ thing gsum/ sil/ sum gnyis/ āḥ rang byung lhun grub= sa la skyolaḥ raṃ yaṃ khaṃḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ḥ 'og min= dpa' bo= nyi shu= nang= spyi bor dza len+da ra sogasaḥ gdan gsum tshang ba'i dkyil 'khor naḥ bzhugs pa'i= lhu gcig grangs bas/ mdor naḥ mthar sum gcig sil bzhag rgya dung chen/ tshogs drang ba dang lan/ bdag lus= bsam lhun sogs/ sangs rgyas kun 'dus pad+ma thod phreng gis// bdag sogs rjes bzung tshe rabs thams cad du// 'gal rkyen kun zhi bsam don lhun grub nas// mthar thug pad+ma 'od du skye bar shog lhag zhus/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lhag ma'i dam tshig 'dod yon gyi phung po zad mi shes pa nam mkha' gang bar gyur/ e ral+li hriṃ hriṃ pheṃ dzaḥ oṃ badza puṣ+pe= dung thing gcig sil/ ḍā/ sum gnyis/ lhag ma mthar sum gcig sil (16)bzhag dung*/ rkang bzhi ḍā/ gsol ka 'gugs pa nas bkra shis rtsol/ sum gcig sil sum gnyis/ dung rgya/ rkang gsum/ hūm̐ḥ bzhengs shig mkha' 'gro= mthar sum gnyis/ dung*/ hūm̐ḥ dus gsum= hūm̐ḥ dpal gyi= mthar rgya radung*/ hūm̐ḥ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i= mthar sum gcig sil bzhag rol/ dung ṇir bkug ste sbre pa/

las byang mchod pa/ zhi rol dung rgya dkar/ ḍā/ bstod pa/ hūm̐ḥ ye shes = bshags pa yig brgya/ dngos grub/ hoḥmakha' 'gro= zhi rol dal myur spel ma= rgya dung dkar/ 'dir ni gzugs dang= hoḥ chu las= rjes thob= hoḥmakha' 'gro ma yi= hoḥ snang srid thams cad= hoḥ rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i= mthar rgya dung*/ sum gcig thing gsum sil/ ḍā/ rkang gsum/ bzhag rol/ bsod nams 'di yis= 'das pa'i sangs rgyas= dngos grub rgya mtsho'i= bskal mang gong nas= gang du skyes pa'i= chos tshul= rgyal ba= sa la= thub bstan= snga 'gyur= bkra shis= bkra shis= bslab pa= phan bde'i= bde gshegs sras= rgyal ba'i= de ltar 'grub par= snang grags rig gsum= sod kyis 'grub bo/ ces pa'ang theg mchog ston pa sprul sku dga' rab rdo rjes byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas mchog dpal brda go lha ri 'od gsal gling gi rig 'dzin bdus pa'i sde'i thugs dam bsnyel gsos su pad+ma ma ṇis bris pa dge legs 'phel// (17)༈ nyer lnga'i tshogs bskang gi dung gling 'bud tshul ni/ thog mar sems bskyed sdom mchog te/ phun sum tshogs pa'i sogs nas/ na mo rat+na tra ya ya/ nas zhi rol/ dung dkar rgya dril/ gshegs su gsol mthar zhi rol/ dung dkar rgya dril/ de nas yum ka'i brgyud 'debs 'don/ mthu thob shog dung chen/ dril/ thing gsum sil/ ḍā/ rkang gsum/ bzhag rol/ dkar gtor/ gang dag sogs nas/ du gsol/ dung chen/ zhi rol/ dkar/ dril/ bgegs gtor 'gor/ dung chen/ dril/ thing gsum zil/ sum gnyis/ rdo rje gzhom/ dung chen/ sum gcig sil/ rkang bzhi/ sum gnyis/ byin 'bebs 'gor sum gnyis/ dung chen/ rgya/ g.yab dar dmar gcig mthar/ dngos grub stsol nas brgyud gsum rol mo/ sil/ ḍā/ rkang bzhi/ bzhag rol/ rgya dung chen/ mchod rlabs mthar/ dung chen/ rgya ḍā/ thing gcig zil/ sum gnyis/ spyan 'dren 'gor/ rgya rkang bzhi/ dung chen g.yab gcig sum gnyis/ mthar/ g.yab/ rgya dung*/ rkang bzhi/

ḍā/ 'jam rol/ sum gnyis/ mchod pa mthar/ 'jam rol/ rgya/ rkang*/ ḍā sum2 bstod pa mthar/ dung chen/ sum gcig sil/ bzhag rol/ de nas mchod phreng*/ nam mdzod mthar/ zhi rol/ rgya/ dung*/ dkar/ ḍā pad+ma rgyas pa= lha mo bzhi re'i mtshams su/ zhi rol bzhi la/ rgya dung*/ dkar/ las byang gzhung mchod/ zhi rol/ rgya/ dung*/ dkar/ ḍā/ bstod pa/ yig brgya/ lan gcig dril bu bsil/ gsol kha 'don/ dam can rgya mtsho'i sogs nas/ kun 'grub mdzod/ sum gcig zil/ bzhog la/ dung rgya/ na raka skong bshags/ hūm̐ḥ ma bcos= man bzhi dril/ tsho bzhi la zhi rol (18)rgya dung dkar hūm̐ḥbaka' gsang rmad du= nas/ zhi rol/ rgya dung dkar/ ḍā/ tshogs 'gor tshogs grol yod na/ dung rgya rkang bzhi thingagasung sil sum gnyis/ med na rgya/ dung chen/ thing gcig hoḥ bde ba= sogs nas rgya dung chen/ sum gnyis/ hūm̐ḥ 'og min nas lhu gsum la/ sum gnyis re/ rgya dung chen/ hoḥ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i mthar/ 'jam rol bzhag rol kha 'bud med/ skong bshags/ na moḥbade gshegs= lhug nam mdzod mthar/ rkang bzhi dung rgya/ g.yab/ thing gsum/ sil sum gnyis/ sa la skyolaḥ rjes/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ḥ 'og min= nas/ bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo= lhu gcig grangs bsog mdor na= mthar sum gcig sil/ bzhag rgya dung*/ drang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ḥ pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ ha ho hriḥ lhag ma'i dam tshig 'dod yon gyi phung po zad mi shes pas nam mkha' gang bar gyur/ e a ral+li hriṃ hriṃ pheṃ dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe= dung*/ thingagacig sil/ ḍā/ sum gnyis/ lhag ma la mthar/ sum gcig sil/ bzhag dung*/ rkang*/ ḍā/ gsol ka mjug bkra shis stsol/ sum gcig sil sum gnyis/ dung rgya rkang gsum/ bskul pa mthar/ sumalaganyis/ dung*/ chad tho'i mthar sum gnyis/ hūm̐ḥ dpal gyi= mthar/ rgya dung*/ hūm̐ḥ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i= mthar sum gcig sil/ dung ṇir bkug te sbrel/ bzhag dung rkang*/ ḍā gsol ka'i mjug bkra shis stsol/ sum gcig sil sum gnyis/

dung rgya/ rkang gsum/ bskul pa mthar/ sum gnyis/ dung*/ chad tho'i mthar sum gnyis/ hūm̐ḥ dpal gyi= mthar/ rgya/ dung*/ hūm̐ḥ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i mthar sum gcig sil/ dung ṇir bkug te sbrel/ las byang mchod pa/ zhi rol/ rgya dung dkar ḍā/ hūm̐ḥ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i= bshags/ yig brgya gsum/ dngos grub/ hoḥ mkha' 'gro sgrub pa'i/ zhi rol dal myur spel ma/ rgya/ dung dkar/ sogs nas bkra shis/ hoḥ rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i mthar/ rgya dung sum gcig zil ḍā/ rkang gsum/ bzhag rol/ des 'grub/ (19)༈ seng gdong gtor bzlog gi dung rgya 'bud tshul/ tshig bdun gsol 'debs/ rol mo byin rlabs la/ dung chen/ rkang gling*/ ḍā/ dkor gtom dung dkar/ bgegs bskrad mgor dung chen/ mthar dung chen/ rkang gsum/ srung 'khor mthar dung chen/ bsdu dus mchod rlab mthar lha bskyed/ byin 'bebs mthar/ dung chen/ rgya/ zil rkang bzhi/ mchod rlabs mthar zhi rol/ rgya/ dung chen/ dkar/ rten bskyed 'gor/ dung chen/ rgya/ spyan 'dren/ dung chen/ rkang bzhi/ rgya/ spyan 'dren mthar/ dung*/ rgya/ rkang bzhi/ mchod pa'i mthar= dung*/ rgya/ rkang bzhi/ bstod pa'i mthar/ dung rgya/ stong tshig mchod bstod/ rgya dung dkar/ tshogs 'gor/ dung chen/ rgya/ sum brdung rnams la/ dung*/ rgya/ bskang ba'i 'gor/ dung*/ rgya/ bshags pa'i mthar kha 'bud med/ bskul pa'i mgor= dung*/ rkang bzhi/ gser skyems/ dung chen/ rkang bzhi/ mthar rkang*/ dung chen/ gzu dpang mthar dung chen/ rkang gsum/ 'gugs pa lan gsum/ dung chen/ rkang bzhi/ yang shar re/ yang 'gugs pa tshar gsum/ mtha' rnams dung chen/ rkang gsum/ de nas mtshams rnams su dung chen/ gris btub mthar rkang bzhi drag 'bud/ zhal stab mthar/ dung chen/ rkang gsum/ lhag ma'i 'gor dung mthar dung chen/ rkang gsum/ bzlog pa 'gor/ dung chen/ rkang bzhi/ mtshams rnams su/ dung chen rkyang pa/ mthar bzhag rol/ dung chen/ rkang gsum/ yang bzlog pa mdos 'gor/ dung chen/

rkang bzhi/ mthar/ bzhag rol/ sum 'bud re/ de nub bskul pa 'gor/ dung chen/ rkang bzhi/ mthar bzhag rol/ sum 'bud/ 'gugs pa 'dra/ thun gtor/ dung chen/ mthar dung chen/ dgra bgegs (20) dpung bcom dang po dang tha mar rkang bzhi/ zil nang sum 'bud/ zhag mang la bgegs dpung bcom nub ya las mi dgos/ chad brtan rnams la dung chen/ brtan ma la/ rgya gling*/ bro mnan mthar rkang bzhi/ dung chen/ rgya/ rjes chog mchod pa/ dung chen/ rgya/ bkra shis mthar dung chen/ rgya/ rkang gsum/ sgo dbye la thug dus/ dang po rkang gling lnga 'bud/ zil nang bzhi 'bud/ dung chen/ sgo dbye'i mthar/ dung chen/ rkang gsum/ chad mdo'i mthar sum gcig zil/ dgra bgegs dpung bcom nges med/ rkang gling lan mang 'bud/ zil/ rkang bzhi/ bskul pa/ gser skyems/ 'gugs pa bcas kyi mthar bzlog rol chung ba/ zor bskul kyi mtshams thams cad la dung chen dang rkang gling yod/ 'gugs pa dang thun gtor la dgra gegs dpung 'dzoms drag brdung*/ srung 'khor la drag brdung*/ zil nang dung chen 'bud/ bzhag rol/ phyir pheb nas bka' brgyad la/ za lam bzhag sar/ bdud pra/ thing gcig zil bzhag rol/ dung chen/ sgo drung*/ oṃ= thing gcig sil sum brdung*/ dung*/ rgya/ brtan ma/ bzhag rol/ 'gugs rol/ dgu byas sum brdung*/ bro mnan/ sum brdung*/ las byang gi bkra shis/ bzhag rol/ a yur dzñā na tshe bh+ruṃ/ thang gcig sum brdung*/ tshe 'gugs/ bzhag rol/ rgya/ dung*/ gral la 'dug thang gsum zil/ sum brdung*/ dung rgya/ dngos grub bskul pa la sum brdung rtse med/ bzhag rol/ srung ma'i gtor 'bul/ rjes chog mchod bstod/ bkra shis rol mo rgyas par bya'o/ ༈ yum ka'i seng gdong 'don 'grigs ni/ sems bskyed sdom chog seng gdong brgyud 'debs/ rol mo byin rlabs rgyas bsdus gang mos/ rang gi= sogs/ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i= sogs/ dzaḥ skyabs sems/ rig 'dus yan bdun tshogs zhing bsdu/

dkar gtor/ bgegs gtor nas/ bstod pa yan/ sengha mu kha= bsnyen/ aka= bsnyen/ 'od zer= hūm̐ḥ bsnyen/ gong gi mchod bstod/ yig brgya/ mdun bskyed/ lha bskyed las byang nas sab/ shar tshogs grol na/ mdun bskyed mchod pa'i mthar/ bzhag rol tshogs grol/ yar tshogs/ thing gsum sil/ sum gnyis bstod pa yan 'don/ bdud 'dul= a ka= sham can bzla/ bdag nyid mkha' 'gro= a ka= srung sngags btags pa bzla/ hūm̐ḥ srung 'khor= a ka= bzlog sngags can bzla/ sangs rgyas= tshig mthar thal rdeb gsum/ mchod phreng ngam mdun bskyed mchod bstod/ yig brgya/ gsol ka ma mgon nas/ sku gsum brgyud gsum= mthar/ dam can rgya mtsho= yan/ spro na na rag skong bshags/ tshogs byin brlabs nas/ bshags nas sku gsung thugs kyi= 'jam rol/ rkang bzhi/ dung chen/ (Musical notes and signs here) hūm̐; zhi ba chos kyi dbyings las= 'di drag brdung chung ba yin/ tshar bcad deḥ skye med dbyings la sbyor ba'i phrin las mdzodaḥ (Musical notes and signs here) dgu brdung glog ma 'di rigs la dgu 'then ? 'then ? gtan nas med/ rkang bzhi/ dung chen/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ gser skyems= 'ur/ sum gnyis/ hūm̐ḥ rig 'dzin (Musical notes and signs here) rtsa brgyud bla ma la (22) lhug 'don/ mthar sum gcig 'ur/ dung chen/ rkang bzhi/ sum gnyis/ hūm̐ḥ khyab bdag= gdod ma ma'i= lhug 'don/ mthar 'jam rol/ rkang gsum/ dung chen/ bzhag rol/ hūm̐ḥ rten dang brten pa= lhug brtsonaḥ (Musical notes and signs here) na mo/ (Musical notes and signs here) rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud= 'gugs rol spyi ltar la/ dang po gsum pa gnyis 'ur cung rtsing*/ bar pa 'jam/ 'gugs rol gsum pa/ (Musical notes and signs here) dzaḥ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang ཿ yi dam lha yi ting 'dzin dang ཿ sngags rgod rdzas kyi= 'ur/ 'di drag brdung 'bring po yin/ sdoms: dril bus brtan pa phral bar gyiḥ dung chen 'bud/ lha dang phrol zhig pra be shaḥ

rkang bzhi/ 'ur/ 'di man grol nyin bar dgu thing bya nas 'ur mthar/ hūm̐: snying rjes bsgral ba'i dam tshig niḥ 'a dur/ nasaḥ rnam par shes pa rdo rje sgomaḥ sngag sadal 'don/ hūm̐: dbyings na/ bzhugs pa'i= 'dur/ rten dang brten pa chos kyi dbyings su sgrol: sngags lhug dal/ hūm̐ḥ drang srong khros pa'i mtshon cha niḥ 'di tshar gnyis 'don na legs pas snga mar/

snang grags rig sum= skye ba kun tu= yig brgya bzla bzhin grol bas 'grub bo/ 'bad pas bgyis pa don yod cing*// chos ldan bya bas rtag tu brtson// zab lam snying thig snying po'i don// bsgrub nas don gnyis lhun grub shog ces pa'ang rnam dkar sgrub pa po pad+ma ma ṇis so// bzlog rol che ba/ thing gsum/ zil/ (Musical notes and signs here) (37) ༈ 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed khro chu dug sdong gi bzlog pa spu gri reg gcod kyi 'don 'grigs mkhas grub karma chags med zhal lung zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ 'khor 'das phyag rgyas zil gnon he ru ka'i// karma'i rang gzugs mngon spyod drag shul dbal// chags thogs med pa'i khro chu dug gi sdong*/ lhag lhar gus btud de'i 'don 'grigs bri/ rten mchod sogs stod smad kyi yo byad rnams mkhas grub chags med pa'i zin bris bzhin 'du byas nas 'don 'grigs ni/ hrīḥsdon gyi= mchod brlabs/ spos phyung*/ 'jam dpal pad 'byung= sogs kyi brgyud 'debs/ rnying sngon dang sbrel ba'i gnam lcags go mtshon gyi skyabs 'gro/ dus 'di nas bzung= sogs tshig bzhi lan gsum/ snang grags chos rnams= sogs tshig bzhi dang*/ rnying sngon nas/ der bzung byang chub= sogs dang*/ 'gro kun bde ldan = sogs tshig gnyis/ hūm̐ las rdo rje= sogs nas rnying sngon gyi/ dkar gtor/ bgegs gtor btang*/ bgegs bskrad pa ni/ hūm̐ḥ nga ni dpal ldan gshin rje'i gshedaḥ sogs nas/ hur thuṃ rbada.a: srung 'khor ni/ si tu'i las byang las/ hūm̐: steng yang ral gri'i= sogs nas/ dgra gegs 'byung po tshar chod ci: bar dang*/ 'di man las byang btang lugs la gsum las/ dang po rgyas pa'i lugs ni/ gnam lcags go mtshon las/ hūm̐ḥbasam brjod bral ba'i= sogs nas/ dug gi me dpung klong nas bzhengs: bar nar 'don 'gros btang mtshams zab gnad sbrel na bskul ring las phyung ba/ gsang ba'i yum chen dun ti nag mo ni:

sku mdog mthing nag zhag cig phyag bzhi ma: spyan gsum sdang mig dbu skra thur du 'phyang: rus pa'i rgyan dang gzig gi shams thabs can: thod skam bu rgyan thod phreng do shal byasaḥ (38)phyag g.yas 'og ma'i kyus dgra gegs 'gugs : phyag g.yas dang po'i ral gris dgra gegs bsgral: pyag g.yon dang po lcags sgrog byad ma bsdom: 'og mas thod khrag dgra gegs snying khrag stob: zhabs gnyis yab kyi lte bar 'khril zhing 'khyud: zhes pa'i bar sbyar bas/ de yi thugs kar rdo rje= sogs nas/ rak+ta la kha raṃ khā hi: bar nar 'gros dang*/ bzlas dmigs ni/ dbu gsum mchod rten= sogs nas/ mu ne brgya'am nyer gcig bud+dha dha ra brgya'am nyer gcig wa gi shwa ri brgya'am nyer gcig ma ṇi brgya'am nyer gcig badz+ra pa ṇi brgya'am nyer gcig yang wa gi shwa ri mum̐ brgya tsam / mañdzu shri ya man+ta ka 'go la sbyar pa nyer gcig du tri man stong tsam/ 'og gi mdun du e las= sogs nas/ bcom par gyuraḥ rjes su rtsa sngags/ du tri ya ma rā dza= nas sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ 'og gi du tri ya ma= sogs nas / s+t+waṃ bha ya nan: bar sbrel ba nyer gcig tsam/ hūm̐:phyi snod 'jig rten= sogs nas/ grub par mdzodaḥ bar dang/ srung dmigs/ rang gi thugs kar= sogs nas/ rdo rje'i sku thob gyur: rtsa sngags du tril yum sngags ru ru rak+mo rak+ṣa ma bh+yo dza dzaḥ zhes dang*/ bdag cag sogs sbyar ba nyer gcig bzlog dmigs/ rang gi spyi gtsug= sogs nas/ chal chal btang bar gyur: rtsa sngags du tri tshang ma la/ 'og gi bzlog sngags sbyar ba nyer gcig tsam/ des bdag bskyed grub nas/ mdun bskyed ni/ situ'i las byang las/ hūm̐ḥ bsam brjod bral ba'i= sogs nas/ nar 'gros las srung zlog ldeb dzar tshad gnyis mi sbyar/ srid gsum ma lus lto bar gsal ba'o: zhes pa'i rjes su/ gsang ba'i yum chen dun tig= sogs nas/ lte bar (39)'khril zhing 'khyud: zhes pa'i bar gong ltar 'dir yang sbyar/

gnam lcags las kyi gshin rje= sogs nas nar 'gros kyis/ spyan 'dren/ bzhugs phyag mchod pa dang*/ bstod pa'i/ sems dpa' chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal stod: zhes pa'i bar btang*/ de nas gsol kha/ hūm̐ḥ dgra bo byad ma rnams ni bsgral ba yi: dmar chen khrag gi mchod yon sogs nas/ a mṛ ta la kha hi 'i bar dang*/ mnga' gsol/ hūm̐: las kyi gshin rje nag po mthu bo che: sogs nas/ grub par mdzod ces pa'i mtha' bar btang ba rgyas pa'i lugs so// las byang 'bring po'i lugs btang tshul ni/ nyin gnyis pa sogs la btang na/ hrīḥ sngon= spos phyung rjes/ brgyud 'debs/ de nas si tu'i las byang gi/ skyabs sems/ bgegs bskrad/ srung 'khor/ de nas/ si tu'i las byang gi hūm̐: bsam brjod bral ba'i= sogs nas nar 'gros/ bskyed rim 'dis bdag mdun dbyer med du bsgom dgos/ me rab tu dmar lhab lhab tu 'bar ba= zhes pa'i rjes su zur dzar/ de'i phyi raul du 'jam dpal dkar po= sogs nas/ gzhal yas khang gi dbus su= bar sbyar/ gzhung gi e las chos 'byung gru gsum= sogs nas/ lto bar gsal ba'o: zhes pa'i mtshams su yab yum bskyed/ gsang ba'i yum chen dun tig= sogs nas/ lte bar 'khril zhing 'khyud= bar gong lhar blang*/ gnam lcags las kyi gshin rje= sogs/ rdo rje'i sogs nas/ yaḥdamar nag gi mtshan pa'o/ zhes pa'i bar sbyar/ de'i mdun du sku yi sprul pa= sogs nas/ ya dang hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'o/ zhes pa'i bar zur dzar/ rang gi thugs ka'i phyi rim sogs nasanar 'gros/ spyan 'dren/ bzhugs phyag mchod pa/ sman mchod mthar mtshan don sbyar ba spro na/ 'jam dpal gshin rje 'jam dpal bshes gnyen dang*// pad 'byung khrag 'thung nag po nor bu 'dzin// gnubs chen gter (40)ston zhang khrom dar dbang la// sman mchod 'bul lo mthu dbang dngos grub stsol// sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi// shaka rdor a grags a dbang sman lung pa// gnyen sras chos bla ku ma rā dza dang*// kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po klong chen par// sman=

sarba= 'od gsal rdo rje bde chen sangs rgyas mtshan// kun dga' se ston spyan tshab chos rgyal mtshan// byang bdag don yod karma chags med la// sman= sarba= 'jam dpal zhi khro khro chu dug gi sdong*// gsang yum las gshin dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i lha// mkha' 'gro chos skyong snang srid gzhir bzhengs lhar// sman= sarba= oṃ āḥhūm̐: sku gsung thugs= sogs nas bstod pa'i/ sems dpa' chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: zhes pa'i bar dang*/ bsnyen dmigs ni/ gnam lcags go mtshon las/ dbu gsum mchod rten sogs nas/ bzlas pa rnams sngar ltar la/ du tri bsnyen pa'i rjes su/ bdag bskyed zhal nas= sogs nas/ du tri= brgya tsam/ mdun bskyed gnas gsum sogs nas/ tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐/ mdun du e las= sogs nas/ bsnyen pa nyer gcig tsam/ 'og gi srung dmigs/ rang gi thugs kar= sogs nas/ rdo rje'i sku thob gyur/ du tri ya ma rā dza= sogs nas/ sa ma dza dzaḥ yum sngags/ ru ru rak+mo rak+sha ma bh+yo dza: zhes dang*/ bdag cag dpon slob= sogs sbrel ba nyer gcig rang gi spyi gtsug =sogs bzlog dmigs dang*/ bzlog sngags sham sbyar nyer gcig de nas mchod bstod kyi tshab tu gsol kha mnga' gsol bcas bya'o// las byang bsdus pa'i lugs btang na/ (41) hrīḥsngon= spros phyung*/ brgyud 'debs/ de nas khro chu gnam lcags go mtshan kyi/ skyabs sems/ rnying sngon bgegs gtor mtha'i gats+tsha'i rjes/ sum bha ni=sogs sbyar/ mtshams gcod/ hūm̐: nga ni dpal ldan= sogs nas nar 'gros/ bdag mdun dbyer med kyis/ spyan 'dren bzhugs phyag mchod pa bsnyen dmigs/ bzlas pa du tri bsnyen gyi bar dang*/ bdag bskyed zhal nas=sogs dang*/ mdun bskyed/ gnas gsum = sogs dang*/ mdun du e las= sogs nas nar 'gros/ mchod bstod/ srung bzlog dmigs bzlas yan song nas gsol ka dang*/ mnga' gsol sbyar ro/ bskul ring gnam lcags 'bar ba'i rngams sgra'i bskang bzlog bskul gsum sbrel mar 'dir btang yang chog

de ltar na bskang mdon ni las byang gi tshogs kyi bskang ba'i rjes su bya'o// de nas rang gi rgyun gyi chos skyong gtor 'bul sogs btang na 'dir sbyar/ de nas tshogs/ hūm̐: nyon cig bgegs dang= sogs nas/ bsang basbyang*/ spyan 'dren/ tshogs 'bul/ tshogs phud mthar/ gnam chos gtor bsngo/ bskang thung sbyar na/ brkang rdzas rnams kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin lta bur gyur/ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ hūm̐: bskang ngo bskal pas=

sogs nas/ phrin las rnam bzhi'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol: bar btang ngo*/ spro na bskul ring bar chad kun sel gnam lcags 'bar ba'i rngams sgra'i/ hūm̐: dad pa dang ni dam tshig= sogs nas/ bdag gi yid la re ba 'grub par mdzod: bar dang*/ bskang mdos las bzhi mchog stsol gyi/ byin rlabs sngags 'bul nas/ mthar dbyung ngo*// de nas sgral las btang lugs la rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum du gsungs pas/ dang po rgyas pa'i lugs ni/ phaṭaḥ bdag mdun gnyis kyi bar du brub khung= sogs nas/ 'gugs pa gsum/ bden chung dgu/ rtsa rgyud gsum/ bh+yoḥ khro chu dug sdong dus la babs: gshed chen sde bzhi'i dus la= sogs nas/ bla 'gugs sngags nyer gcig lha dbye/ bskul pa*/ 'og ta spro na gnam lcags rngams sgra'i/ e ya bh+yo: rim pa bdun gyi sa non= nas/ mthar byung ngo*/ phur bdab/ thun/ rdul phran bzhin du med par gyis: bar gyis bsgral/ zhal bstab/ hūm̐: 'jigs byed ya man+ta ka= sogs nas/ rdul phran bzhin du brlag byas te: khro chu dug sdong zhal du bstab :(42) 'khor gyi las gshin zhal du bstab: bzhes shig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi: rtsa sngags dutra ི'i sham du/ dgra bgegs kyi don snying= sogs nas/ khā hi'i bar dang*/ bzlog dmigs/ bdag mdun gyi gtso 'khor= sogs nas/ las mdzad par bsgom= bar dang*/ bzlog gzhung gi/ rang gi spyi gtsug= sogs nas/ bzlog sngags sham sbyar brgya/ bzlog gzhung dngos ni/ hūm̐: las kyi gshin rje nag po= sogs nas/ lhu dang po btang*/ 'og gi/ bh+yo:phyogs phyogs de ni pha ki na: nyi ma lho phyogs= sogs nas/ ban bon sngags pa'i byad kha zlog: bar dang*/ gong gi/ bh+yo: sngon tshe bzlog pa gang nas byung: sogs nas/ tha ma bzlog pa 'di ltar bzlog: bar dang*/ 'og gi/ hūm̐: nga ni 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed: 'jig rten dregs pa= sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa 'gyed: dus 'dir bzlog bsgyur dus la bab: bdag cag yon mchod=

chags che nyam nga= sngon gyi las= 'phral gyi=yas kyi bdud kha= sogs nas/ bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod: zhes pa'i bar btang*/ bzlog sngags tshar gsum tsam btang*/ des gtso bo'i bsad bzlog song*/ thun gnyis pa ni/ 'gugs pa/ na mo/ drin chen= sogs tshar gcig dang*/ bh+yo: 'chi bdag nag po'i dus la bab: dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dam nyams sdig can las ngan 'di: lcags dkyu 'bar bas= sogs nas/ 'gugs sngags bdun tsam/ si tu'i las byang nang gi bsgral ba/ hūm̐: nga ni las kyi gshin rje yin: sogs/ nyung thun/ phur thun/ ral gri'i thun/ gtun brdung bcas kyis bsgral/ gong gi zhal bstab/ hūm̐: 'jigs byed ya man+ta ka= sogs nas/ rdul phran bzhin du brlag byas nas: 'chi bdag nag po'i (43)zhal du bstab: bzhes shig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi: bar dang*/ bzlog pa/ hūm̐/ sku yi sprul pa 'chi bdag nag po= sogasalhu gcig bh+yo: sngon tshe bzlog pa gang nas= sogs nas/ tha ma bzlog pa 'di ltar bzlog: bar dang*/ hūm̐: nga ni 'chi bdag nag po sku: sku yi sprul pas nam mkha' gang: dus 'dir bzlog bsgyur dus la bab: bdag cag yon mchod sogs nas mthar dbyung ngo*/ thun gsum pa ni/ 'gugs pa dang*/ bh+yo: tshe bdag nag po'i dus la bab: dam rdzas= dam nyams= lcags kyu= sogs las byang gi bsgral las thun gnyis pa ltar la/ zhal bstabs/ tshe bdag nag po'i zhal du bstab= bzhes shig= bzlog pa/ hūm̐: gsung gi sprul pa= sogs dang*/ bh+yo: sngon tshe bzlog pa= sogs dang*/ hūm̐: nga ni tshe bdag= gsung gi= dus 'dir= bdag cag sogs mtha' phud/ thun bzhi pa la 'gugs pa dang*/ bh+yo: srog bdag nag po'i= dam rdzas= sogs dang*/ zhal bstab la/ srog bdag nag po'i zhal= sogs/ bzlog pa/ thugs kyi sprul pa= sngon tshe= hūm̐: nga ni srog bdag= thugs kyi= dus 'dir sogs brjod/ thun lnga pa la/ 'gugs pa dang*/ bh+yo: be bā sa twa'i= sogs dang*/ zhal bstab la/ be bā sa twa'i zhal du bstab:

bzlog pa/ yon tan sprul pa= sngon tshe= hūm̐: nga ni be bā sa twa'i= yon tan= sogs brjod/ thun drug pa la/ 'gugs pa dang*/ bh+yo: za ba ljang dmar= zhal bstab la/ za ba ljang dmar= bzlog pa/ phrin las sprul pa= sngon tshe= hūm̐: nga ni za ba ljang nag= phrin las sogs brjod/ thun bdun pa la 'gugs pa/ bh+yo: ya ma rā dza'i= zhal bstab la/ (44)ya ma rā dza'i= bzlog pa/ hūm̐: gnyis med sprul pa= sngon tshe= hūm̐: nga ni ya ma rā dza'i= gnyis med= sogs brjod/ de ltar thun bdun la 'gugs pa tshig lhug la bsdu na/ dkon mchog gsum dang tshe bdag nag po'i mthus: bdag cag 'khor bcas tshe bsod dbang thang la: gnod pa'i bdud dang dgra bgegs ma lus pa: ru tra'i gzugs la dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥkhug: ces gnam lcags go mtshon las byung ba dang*/ 'gugs bskul si tu'i las byang las/ hūm̐: chos sku skye med ngang las ma g.yos kyang: thabs kyi cho 'phrul khro chu dug gi sdong: khrag 'thung sogs sbyar/ 'khor rnams la/ thabs kyi cho 'phrul las gshin 'chi bdag nag: tshe bdag nag: srog bdag nag: be bā satwa nag: za ba ljang: thabs kyi cho 'phrul ya ma rā dza rje: zhes kha bsgyur ro/ bsgral las 'bring po thun gsum ma byed na/ gtso bo'i bzlog pa yan sngar ltar song nas/ thun gnyis pa la/ 'gugs pa dang*/ bh+yo: 'chi bdag nag po'i dus la bab: tshe bdag nag po'i dus= srog bdag nag po'i= dam rdzas gtor ma= sogs dang*/ bsgral las las byang ltar/ zhal bstab la/ 'chi bdag nag po'i zhal du bstab: tshe bdag nag po'i= srog bdag nag po'i= bzhes shig= bzlog pa sku gsung thugs sbrel/ sngon tshe= sogs dang*/ hūm̐: nga ni 'chi bdag nag po'i sku: sku yi sprul pas= nga ni tshe bdag= gsung*/ nga ni srog bdag thugs kyi= dus 'dir sogs (45) sngar ltar/ thun gsum pa la/ 'gugs pa dang*/ bh+yo: bhe ba sa twa'i dus= za ba ljang dmar= ya ma rā dza'i= dam rdzas/ sogs dang*/ zhal bstab la/ bhe ba sa twa'i zhal du=

za ba ljang dmar= ya ma rā dza'i= bzlog pa yon tan phrin las gnyis med gsum sbrel/ hūm̐: sngon tshe =sogs dang*/ hūm̐: nga ni be ba sa twa'i sku: yon tan= nga ni za ba= phrin las= nga ni ya ma= gnyis= dus 'dir= sogs brjod/ bsgral las bsdus pa ni/ mar 'gros kyis gzhung na ji ltar yod pa ltar byas/ bzlog pa yang mar 'gros kho na bya'o/ bzlog pa tshar grangs bsog dgos na/ si tu'i las byang nang gi/ bh+yo: phyogs phyogs de ni pha ki na: nyi ma lho phyogs pha ki na: las kyi gshin rje'i= tsha ba'i me= sogs bskul pa de bsog rgyu legs/ spro na gnam lcags 'bar ba'i rngams sgra'i/ hūm̐ ya: bcom ldan 'jam dpal khro chu dug sdong gi: sogs nas/ yum bskul yan/ de nas rtsang gyer/ hūm̐ ya: 'jam dpal gshin rje= sogs nas/ grub bar mdzod: bar dang*/ tshogs drang ba/ gzigs shig= sogs dang*/ lhag ma/ dang po phud kyi= sogs btang*/ gnam chos dkar gtor dang*/ go mtshan gyi thun gtor/ e:gtor snod gru gsum= sogs dang*/ byad ma mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa la kha raṃ khā hi: bar dang*/ si tu'i las byang gi/ hūm̐:phyogs phyogs de ni= sogs bskul pa des nub snga ma rnams thun gtor bzlog gtor du phul/ nub phyi ma rnams la zor du 'phang*/ chad tho/ hūm̐: sngon tshe 'das dus= sogs nas/ myur du mdzod: bar dang*/ brtan ma ni/ bh+yo: slob dpon pad+ma thod phreng gi: bka' nyan ma mo brtan ma'i tshogs: dam rdzas dpal gyi gtor ma long: bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod: zhes dang*/ (46)bstan ma chen mo khyed rnams= sogs brjod/ bro 'gugs dang*/ rta bro/ hūm̐:phyogasamed phyogs dang= sogs nas/ s+t+waṃ bha ya nan: zhes dang*/ bdag cag mchog grub tshe bsod rgyas: dpal 'byor bde bas gang gyur cig: zhes brjod rjes chog ni/ go mtshon gyis/ spyi gtsug mchod rten nor bu= sogs nas/ thim par gyur: rtsa sngags du t-i la aḥyu dzñā na sid+dhi hūm̐: sbrel ba brgya/

skad cig sman sdong= sogs nas/ rtsa sngags du tri la/ sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: btags pa nyer gcig a ka ro= rtsa sngags du tri la ba ling ta btags pa gsum/ oṃ ya man+ta ka= hūm̐:bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal= rtsal du gsol:bar dang*/ rang nyid snang stong yi dam thugs ka= sogs nas/ badz+ra satwa hūm̐: bar dang*/ yig brgya/ a li/ ka li/ rnams lan gsum re/ ye dharmā dang*/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir// nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni// ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid bar// de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol/ si tu'i las byang las/ gzugs snang thams cad= sogs nas/ a a a: zhes pa'i bar dang*/ du tri ya ma rā dza= sogs rtsa sngags tshar gcig gis lhar ldang*/ na mo:'khor gsum yongs su= sogs bsngo smon dang*/ oṃ:chos sku'i bkra shis= sogs/ bkris ji rigs brjod pas mtha' brgyan no/ grol nyin/ lhag ma'i rjes go mtshon thun gtor bskyed 'gugs bstab pa rnams ni/ eḥgator snod gru gsum= sogs nas/ byad ma mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa la kha raṃ khā hi= bar dang*/ gtor brdzong bya ba/ eḥdrag po chos dbyings= sogs nas/ dam rdzas phyi nang gsang ba=(47) tshig gnyis re'i mtshams su 'gres sbyar nas/ mthar sngags bsngos spro na bskul ring gis/ e ya bh+yo: rim pa bdun gyi sa 'og= nas mthar dbyung ngo*/ sgo dbye ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum/ hūm̐ shar gyi phyogs nas= sogs dang*/ dkar gtor stong pa'i ngag las= hūm̐ shar la sogs pa'i phyogs bcu= sogs dang*/ las byang gi chad tho btang*/ ri khar thon nas/ gnam chos dkar gtor/ za lam rnams sbyar na chog bzlog pa bcu gnyis pa'i/ 'gugs pa/ na mo: drin chen= sogs nas rim par nar 'gros/ sgong zor/ khram zor/ mda' zor/ khrag zor/ rdo zor/ kong zor/ dregs pa sde bzhi'i khrag zor rnams 'phang*/ grub par mdzod/ bar ro/ spro na/ ya ma rā dza'i bskul pa/ hūm̐: phyogs phyogs de ni= zhes pa'i tshe ma btang*/

mtshams 'dir zor shin tu rgyas pa byed na/ bzlog pa'i 'khor nas yar 'gros byed par gsungs pas/ hūm̐:gnyis med sprul pa'i= mthar bzlog sngags re sbrel/ hūm̐: phrin las sprul pa'i= hūm̐: yon tan sprul pa'i= hūm̐: thugs kyi sprul pa= hūm̐: gsung gi sprul pa= hūm̐: sku yi sprul pa= hūm̐: las kyi gshin rje'i nag po mthu bo che: sogs bzlog sngags dang sbrel/ hūm̐: lcags sam bhan+dha'i= dmod bcas/ go mtshon las/ rang gi phyag mthil 'dzam gling= sogs nas/ sangs rgyas shog: bar dang*/ bstan ma dang*/ bro mnan bya/ yar phyin nas go mtshan gyi tshe sgrub man chod gong ltar ro/ bsdus pa ni/ rang gi yi dam gang yin gyi tshogs bskang dang 'brel bar/ gnam lcags go mtshon gyi gzhung la par bkab med par de kho na ltar nyams su blang ngo*/ des ni mkhas grub rin po che'i 'don 'grigs ji lta ba bzhin las rang 'dod kyi kha sab ma byas/ spyir 'di dag la bzlas pa dang ting nge 'dzin gal che ba las pod gzhung nang ji yod 'don rgyu mang ba gal mi che bas/ gong du bshad pa 'di dag ni chags med rin po ches dgos ngos su gsungs pa la/ yar lhag pa dang*/ mar chad pa sogs bshags 'os med pa zhig yin no/ rgyal ba'i thu stobs gcig bsdus ya man+ta/ drag rtsal rno myur khro chu'i zhun 'dra 'dis// bstan dgra mngon spyod dug mdas tshar bcad nas/ 'jam dpal chos kyi sdong por 'tshang rgya shog /zhes pa'ang bla ma o rgyan dpal 'byor gyi nyams len gsal byed du pad+ma ma ṇis bris pa dge legs 'phel// dge'o// (48 49) tshe ring ma'i char 'bebs zur 'debs dge legs rgya mtshon ni sprin chen bzhugs/ kun mkhyen yab sras rnams gsum la/ btud de nyer mkho 'ga' zhig bsdebs/ de yang 'phags mchog a rā gas/ nabs so bya rol lag dang rgyal/ phur bu 'dzom pa byung ba'i tshe/ zhed kyi sde mig bzhi zhes bya/ rtarda zla gnyis lnga bdun brgyad dang*/

nyer gnyis nyer gsum nyer lnga dang*/ nyer drug nyer bdun gnam stong dus/ karma deb dang bra nye mgo/ be'u rwa yin lug gi zlar/ gcig gnyis drug brgyad bcu drug dang*/ bco brgyad nyi shu nyer gnyis dang*/ nyer gsum nyer bzhi nyer lnga dang*/ nyer bdun karma rgyal dang skag sprel zlar gcig bzhi bdun brgyad dang*/ bcu gnyis nyer gcig nyer gnyis dus/ mchu dang sa ri smin drug go/ bya zlar lnga dgu nyi shu dang*/ nyer lnga nyer drug 'bab pa'i dus/ sa ri chu stod skag 'bab skar/ klu yi thebs ldog brtsi ba ni/ stag zlar gcig gnyis drug bdun brgyad/ dgu bcu bcu gsum bcu bzhi dang*/ bcu drag bco brgyad nyid shud dang*/ nyer gnyis nyer gsum nyi shu brgyad/ nyer dgu gnam gang la thebs cing*/ lnga dang bco lnga dag la ldog yos zlar gcig (50) gsum bzhi lnga drug bcu gnyis bcu drug nyer gsum dang*/ nyer lnga nyer drug rnams la thebs/ brgya dang bco lnga bco brgyad dang*/ nyi shu nyer bzhi nyer bdun dang*/ nyer brgyad gnam stong rnams la ldog 'brug zlar bcu gnyis bco brgyad dang*/ nyer gnyis nyer lnga nyer dgur thebs/ bzhi lnga bdun dang bco lnga dang*/ bcu bdun nyer gnyis ma gtog ldog/ sbrul zla'i tshes bdun bdud tsir mthong*/ drug brgyad bco lnga bcu drug dang*/ bcu bdun bco brgyad bcu dgu dang*/ nyer drug nyer bdun nyer brgyad thebs/ tshes dgu dug la gcig dang brgyad/ bco brgyad nyer lnga nyi shu brgyad/ nyer dgur ldog la rta zla ba'i/ gnyis lnga bcu gnyis bcu gsum rnams/ bdud rtsir mthong la gsum bdun bcu bcu gnyis bcu gsum bcu drug dang*/ nyi shu nyer gnyis nyi shu gsum/ nyer lnga stong thebs bcu dgur dug drug brgyad bco lnga bcu drug dang*/ bco brgyad nyer gsum nyi shu lnga*/ nyer drug ldog la lug zla ba'i/ lnga brgyad bco lnga bdud rtsir mthong*/ gsum dang bcu drug bcu bzhi dang*/

bco lnga bco brgyad nyi shu dang*/ nyer gnyis nyer gsum nyi shu lnga*/ nyer brgyad rnams thebs gcig dang lnga*/ bcu dang bcu gcig bcu gnyis dang*/ (51)bco lnga bcu drug bcu bdun dang*/ nyi shu nyer gnyis nyer bdun ldog nyer dgur mchod pa dug tu mthong*/ sprel zlar dgu gsum sman mthong zhing*/ gcig bdun brgyad bcu bco lnga dang*/ bcu drug bco brgyad nyi shu dang*/ nyer gnyis nyer bdun nyer brgyad thebs/ bcu drug mchod pa dug mthong zhing*/ lnga drug bcu gcig nyer lngar ldog bya zlar gcig bzhi nyer lnga sman/ lnga bdun brgyad dgu bcu bcu gcig bco lnga bcu bdun nyi shu dang*/ nyer gcig nyer gnyis nyi shu lnga/ nyer bdun nyer brgyad gnam gang thebs/ bcu drug mthong gsum lnga drug bdun dgu bcu gnyis bcu bzhi dang*/ bcu drug nyer bdun rnams la ldog khyi zlar gcig dang bcu bdan dang*/ bco brgyad nyer brgyad bdud rtsir mthong*/ gsum lnga drug brgyad bcu gcig rang*/ bcu gsum bco lnga nyi shu dang*/ ner gcig nyer gnyis nyer gsum thebs/ bdun dgu bcu dang bcu drug dang*/ bcu dgu la ldog nyer dgur ldog phag zlar bzhi lnga bco lnga dang*/ nyer lngar bdud rtsir drug brgyad bcu/ bcu gcig bcu gnyis bco brgyad thebs/ bcu drug nyer drug la ldog cing*/ bcu dgur dug mthong byi ba zla'i/ brgyad dang nyer bdun bdud rtsir mthong*/ gcig bdun (52)bcu dang bcu bdun dang*/ nyi shur thebs la bcu drug dug drug dang nyi shu nyer gsum dang*/ nyer drug rnams ldog glang gi zlar/ thebs med ldog la nyer dgur dug de dag 'dzom sar ma gyur na/ gcig gsum gsum gsum bdun gsum dang*/ brgyad gsum dgu gsum rnams la legs/ gzhan rnams ngan pas 'dod len bya/ gcod yul mkha' 'gro'i gad rgyang nang*/ char 'bebs dmigs pa 'di ltar ro/ phaṭa/ rang rig rang lus nas thon ye shes kyi/ mkha' 'gro dkar mo shel gyi gri gug 'dzin/

bem po'i g.yang gzhi bshus nas bting ba yis/ g.yu yi ne'u gseng chu mig khron pa can/ char 'bebs yul phyogs thams cad khyab pa'i steng*/ sha khrag gtubs pas khrag rnamasa'o ma'i mtsho/ sha rnams dkar gsum klu sman bza' btung tshogs/ dus pa gser dngul rin chen sna tshogs dang*/ klu la mkho ba'i yo byad zad med 'di/ rgyal rigs rje'u rigs dmangs rigs bram ze'i rigs/ gdol pa nag po klu bdud klu btsan dang*/ klu sman mtsho sman gnyan rigs rnams la sbyin/ char gyi rgyun chen da lta nyid du phobs/ khyed rnams mthu rtsal ci 'dug da blta'o/ gal te char chen myur (53)du ma phab na/ gsang bdag pad 'byung ma cig lab sgron sogs/ rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i bla ma'i bka' dang 'gal/ khyed cag rnams la dam tshig chad pas bsdigs/ khyed cag snang srid lha 'dre mthu chen la/ mthu dang nus pa stobs rtsal mi 'dug ces/ 'jig rten skye bo rnams kyis 'phya zhing khrel/ khyed rnams de bas smad bab ci zhig yod/ de phyir mthu rtsal nus pa myur du ston/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ rlung gi dmigs pas char 'bebs na/ chu rlung bum pa can bzung la/ lto ba rgya mtsho chen po'i nang*/ klu rnams bkug nas char 'bebs bsam/ dmigs pa drag tu gtad pas 'grub lte 'og pad 'dab drug pa'i nang*/ rlung lha sngon sha ba zhon/ sha ba'i rkang chag dar mdung sgril/ de 'dra gtso 'khor bdun gsal ba'i/ 'od kyis slang lha dngos su bkug sad 'dab zum steng shākya thub/ 'khor dang bcas pas mnan par bsam/ rlung bzung dmigs pas rlung non gyur/ rig 'dzin mi 'gyur rdo rje yis/ btsan thabs char 'bebs zhal zhes ni/ gri khrag yugs pa ma'i dor dras/ gzha' dang rgyu skar dbang du sdud/ sbal (54)pa'i mgo dang te lo'i shas/ sa bdag klu gnyan gtod la mnan/ yungs dkar gu gul nag po yis/ bar snang lha 'dre yul bdag gzhigs/ lcags ser khrag dang 'brug rgyud kyis/ sprin nag glo bur sdud par byed/

rdzas rnams par so sor zhib btags pala'i/ ril bu sha ba'i ril ma tsam/ byas te nyi ma'i zer 'char nas/ srod phan tshun dbang sdus phrin sdud rdzas/ go rim ma nor sol mer bsreg/ yun ni kha zas bza' yun tsam/ des ni char sprin 'dus pa dang*/ dbab rdzas phag tshil rnying pa dang*/ lkugs pa'i mig dang shing rkun gsum/ bsregs pas cher chen glo bur 'bebs/ rdzas ni tshogs tshad dpung bskyed la/ go rim ma nor gces pa yin/ sbyor ba them cing ma nor na/ 'di la the tshom za mi dgos/ gal te des kyang ma pheb na/ rdzas rnams dril te me la sbra/ chu mig lha rten rnams la bdug gnad 'bebs rang nyid bsrung ba'i phyir/ gla rtsi gu gul nag po dang*/ chu dwags nag po ru dra dang*/ btsan dug thal chen mu zi dang*/ shing kun khrag rdul rma byī mdangs/ de rnams rang gi gnas gsum byung/ sngar gyi rjas rnams dril ba'i steng*/ byang pa mi (55)sha mi rus dang*/ dred mo'i spu dang bong nag tshil/ gul nag yug pa'i mngal khrag dang*/ nya sbal sbrul sdom sdig pa'i sha/ khyi nag blun dang ra thug sbre/ sbur nag de rnams bsreg pa yis/ btsan gyi 'grim srang klu yi gnas/ yul slaha'i rten rnams la bdug cing*/ dbab sngags la ni 'di nyid btags/ a su tri sre du dza dzaḥ nub phyogs klu rgyal dzaḥdzaḥ nā ga dur/ kaṃ rngam tri dzaḥdzaḥ nyā ga dur ki sarba kung dzaḥdzaḥ nā ga dur shi khal dzaḥdzaḥ na ga dur sra ma ti ra hi dzaḥdzaḥ nā ga kaṃ kaṃ sha ru mā ra ya dzaḥdzaḥ oṃ badz+ra dun bh+yo yak+sha tig+na dzaḥs ma ya s+t+waṃ: zhes bzla ting 'dzin drag tu gzigs/ dge tshogs chu 'dzin stug po las/ phan bde'i gru char 'dzad med bsnyil/ rnam mkhyen rgyal ba'i 'bras bzang la/ kun kyang spyod pa'i rdur rgyur cig ces pa'ang pad+ma ma ṇis so/
